title: 🎻 The Music and Art Festival Mystery
intro: Whiskers, Luna, Oliver, and Bella each have a booth at the school festival -- one table for their favorite art medium, and an instrument they play on the little stage next door. Can you match them all up?
clues: Oliver's art medium is not Painting.
Luna's art medium is not Painting, Sculpture, or Collage.
Bella does not play Piano or Violin.
hints: Clue 2 rules out three art mediums for Luna all at once -- whatever's left over is her answer. Start there.
Clue 7 tells you Luna's instrument directly: Violin. Mark that one with confidence!
Clues 4 and 5 don't name a cat -- they link an instrument straight to an art medium. Once you know a cat's medium, check whether it matches either of those clues.
Clue 3 narrows Bella down to just two instruments left. Try combining it with clue 5 (Guitar -> Sculpture) to see which one fits Bella.
Once Bella and Luna are settled, clue 1 and the leftovers sort out Whiskers and Oliver -- use clue 6 last to confirm Oliver's instrument.
